CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTPERIODBALANCE_DEP_ADB_AveCurBal] AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL AS (
-- Average Current Balance & AVE_CURR_BALANCE
SELECT
	bdt.acid,BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
	,'Average Current Balance' AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
	,BDT.TRANDATE AS PeriodStartDate
	,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS BillingCycleId
	,BDT.AVE_CURR_BALANCE AS BalanceAmount
	,BDT.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,BDT.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,BDT.MONTH_YEAR AS PeriodMonthYear
	,BDT.QUARTER_YEAR AS PeriodQuarterYear
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId

	,BDT.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.DEP_TBLMONTHLYADB BDT
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG 
	ON BDT.ACID = BDG.ACID 
	AND BDT.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID
	AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1
WHERE BDT.ISLATEST = 1
--and bdg.foracid = '83ac6b0b78f2b3cad0d514e35079bbc5'
)
--select * from truncate table BUSC.DEP_TBLMONTHLYADB where acid = 'PB342017'

--select * from BUSC.DEP_TBLMONTHLYADB_BU_20230824 where acid = 'PB342017'

--INSERT INTO BUSC.DEP_TBLMONTHLYADB
--SELECT * FROM BUSC.DEP_TBLMONTHLYADB_BU_20230824


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL where CustomerAccountId is not null;


-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)
,convert(varchar,PeriodBalanceTypeId)
,convert(numeric,BalanceAmount)
,convert(char,IsoCurrencyCode)
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
,convert(varchar,PeriodMonthYear)
,convert(varchar,PeriodQuarterYear)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, PeriodBalanceTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL 
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)
,convert(varchar,PeriodBalanceTypeId)
,convert(numeric,BalanceAmount)
,convert(char,IsoCurrencyCode)
,convert(varchar,FinancialInstitutionId)
,convert(varchar,PeriodMonthYear)
,convert(varchar,PeriodQuarterYear)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, PeriodBalanceTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' 
AND PeriodEndDate = '20991231' 
and  PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'Average Current Balance'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
	,ISNULL(SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId,TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId) AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId = TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL_DELTA;


----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET 
PeriodEndDate =  CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartDate))
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
AND DELTA.PeriodBalanceTypeId = TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId 
 AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
 AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
AND SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId = TGT.PeriodBalanceTypeId 
 AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
 AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate = '20991231' 


-----------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance ( 
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodBalanceTypeId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,BillingCycleId
,BalanceAmount
,IsoCurrencyCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,PeriodMonthYear
,PeriodQuarterYear
,SourceSystemCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT DISTINCT
SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId AS PeriodBalanceTypeId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
,'20991231' AS PeriodEndDate
,NULL AS BillingCycleId
,SRC.BalanceAmount AS BalanceAmount
,SRC.IsoCurrencyCode AS IsoCurrencyCode
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,SRC.PeriodMonthYear AS PeriodMonthYear
,SRC.PeriodQuarterYear AS PeriodQuarterYear
,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS TaskRunId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId 
AND DELTA.PeriodBalanceTypeId = SRC.PeriodBalanceTypeId
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('UPDATE','INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TBL_DELTA;

end
GO
